name: anki-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server for Anki spaced repetition flashcard application
long_description:
Transform your Anki experience with natural language interaction - like having a private tutor. This MCP server enables AI assistants to interact with Anki, allowing them to explain concepts, make learning more engaging, provide context, and adapt to your learning style. Features include review sessions, deck management, note creation and editing, and more.

Requires Anki with the AnkiConnect plugin installed.

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Synchronize the local collection with AnkiWeb (network call; Anki must be logged in to AnkiWeb). Other tools see changes from other devices only after a sync

tools.name: get_due_cards
tools.description: Get cards that are due for review, optionally filtered by deck, from the local collection without syncing (answers omitted unless include_answer: true, default false)

tools.name: get_cards
tools.description: Get cards with flexible filtering by state (due, new, learning, suspended, buried) and deck, from the local collection without syncing (answers omitted unless include_answer: true, default false)

tools.name: present_card
tools.description: Return a card's front; the back only when show_answer is true. Does not record a review

tools.name: rate_card
tools.description: Record a real review with the user's rating (Again, Hard, Good, Easy), which sets the card's next due date

tools.name: forgetCards
tools.description: Reset cards to new, discarding their scheduling without recording a review

tools.name: setDueDate
tools.description: Reschedule cards to become due in a given number of days, without recording a review

tools.name: areSuspended
tools.description: Check whether cards are suspended, without changing anything

tools.name: suspend
tools.description: Suspend cards so they're skipped during review until unsuspended. A suspended card silently drops out of the user's reviews until it is unsuspended.

tools.name: unsuspend
tools.description: Unsuspend cards so they return to normal review

tools.name: addNote
tools.description: Add a SINGLE note. addNotes creates several in one call — AnkiConnect processes requests one at a time, so repeated/parallel addNote calls are slower. The note's cards join the user's reviews

tools.name: addNotes
tools.description: Add multiple notes in a single batch — faster than repeated addNote calls. Up to 100 notes sharing the same deck and model. Duplicates are skipped individually; validation errors (empty required fields, bad tags) reject the batch.

tools.name: findNotes
tools.description: Search for notes using Anki query syntax (deck:, tag:, is:due, etc.)

tools.name: notesInfo
tools.description: Get fields, tags, note type and card IDs for notes. CSS is per note type and not included (see modelStyling)

tools.name: updateNoteFields
tools.description: Overwrite existing note fields (HTML supported), optionally appending audio/images downloaded from URLs. Changes do not persist if the note is open in Anki's browser

tools.name: deleteNotes
tools.description: Permanently delete notes and all their cards. Rejected unless confirmDeletion is true

tools.name: modelNames
tools.description: List all available note types/models

tools.name: modelFieldNames
tools.description: Get field names for a specific note type

tools.name: getTags
tools.description: Get all tags in the Anki collection. Helps discover existing tags before creating notes to prevent duplication

tools.name: modelStyling
tools.description: Get CSS styling information for a note type

tools.name: createModel
tools.description: Create a new note type (model) with custom fields, card templates, and CSS styling. Useful for creating specialized models like RTL (Right-to-Left) language models for Hebrew, Arabic, etc.

tools.name: updateModelStyling
tools.description: Replace the entire CSS styling of an existing note type. Changes apply to all cards using this model. Useful for adding RTL support or modifying appearance.

tools.name: modelTemplates
tools.description: Get the card templates (Front and Back HTML) for a specific note type, in the shape updateModelTemplates accepts.

tools.name: updateModelTemplates
tools.description: Replace the Front and Back HTML of named card templates of an existing note type. Each card template defines how the card's front and back sides are rendered. Changes apply to all cards using this model.

tools.name: addModelField
tools.description: Add a new field to an existing Anki note type. Existing notes get the field as empty.

tools.name: removeModelField
tools.description: Remove a field from an existing Anki note type, permanently deleting its data in every note. Rejected unless confirmDeletion is true.

tools.name: renameModelField
tools.description: Rename a field in an existing Anki note type. Anki rewrites references to the old name in the card templates.

tools.name: repositionModelField
tools.description: Change the position/order of a field within an Anki note type (0-based index).

tools.name: guiBrowse
tools.description: Open the Card Browser window in Anki on the user's screen and search for cards. For when the user asks to open the browser; not part of a review session

tools.name: guiSelectCard
tools.description: Change the selection in the open Card Browser window to one card. For when the user asks to select a card

tools.name: guiSelectedNotes
tools.description: Read the IDs of the notes the user has selected in Anki's Card Browser. Changes nothing on screen

tools.name: guiAddCards
tools.description: Open Anki's Add Cards dialog on the user's screen, pre-filled; nothing is saved until the user clicks Add

tools.name: guiEditNote
tools.description: Open Anki's note editor on the user's screen for one note, for editing by hand

tools.name: guiDeckOverview
tools.description: Make a deck current and switch Anki's main window on the user's screen to its overview. Not part of a review session

tools.name: guiDeckBrowser
tools.description: Switch Anki's main window on the user's screen to the deck list. Not part of a review session

tools.name: guiCurrentCard
tools.description: Read the card on Anki's review screen, including its answer (so calling it mid-review reveals the answer). Errors outside review mode

tools.name: guiShowQuestion
tools.description: Flip the card on Anki's review screen to its question side. For when the user asks; not how this server runs reviews

tools.name: guiShowAnswer
tools.description: Flip the card on Anki's review screen to its answer side. For when the user asks; not how this server runs reviews

tools.name: guiUndo
tools.description: Trigger Anki's Edit > Undo, reverting the most recent action in Anki's undo history (which may be the user's own)

tools.name: listDecks
tools.description: List all Anki decks, optionally with per-deck study-queue counts (cards due today, capped by daily limits — not card totals)

tools.name: deckStats
tools.description: Get statistics for a single deck: today's study queue, true card-state counts (new/learning/review/suspended/buried), and ease/interval distributions

tools.name: createDeck
tools.description: Create a new empty Anki deck. Supports parent::child structure (max 2 levels, e.g., "Japanese::JLPT N5")

tools.name: changeDeck
tools.description: Move cards to a different deck. Target deck will be created if it doesn't exist

tools.name: retrieveMediaFile
tools.description: Download a media file from Anki's collection.media folder as base64 content

tools.name: getMediaFilesNames
tools.description: List media files in Anki's collection.media folder, optionally filtered by pattern

tools.name: storeMediaFile
tools.description: Upload a media file to Anki from base64 data, an absolute file path, or a URL. Overwrites a file with the same name by default

tools.name: deleteMediaFile
tools.description: Remove a media file from Anki's collection.media folder; cards that reference it stop showing or playing it

tools.name: addTags
tools.description: Add space-separated tags to specified notes. getTags lists existing tags, which helps avoid near-duplicates

tools.name: removeTags
tools.description: Remove space-separated tags from specified notes

tools.name: replaceTags
tools.description: Rename a tag across specified notes (e.g., "RomanEmpire" -> "roman-empire")

tools.name: clearUnusedTags
tools.description: Remove every tag not used by any note from the collection's tag list; notes are not changed

tools.name: collection_stats
tools.description: Get aggregated statistics across all decks: per-deck study queues plus collection-wide true card-state counts

tools.name: review_stats
tools.description: Get review history analysis including temporal patterns, retention metrics, and study streak information

prompts.name: anki_review
prompts.description: Guided Anki review session workflow with spaced repetition best practices
prompts.text: Guidelines for conducting Anki spaced repetition review sessions. Covers sync workflow, card presentation, rating criteria, and session management.

prompts.name: twenty_rules
prompts.description: Twenty rules of formulating knowledge for effective Anki flashcard creation
prompts.text: Twenty rules of formulating knowledge by Dr. Piotr Wozniak, adapted for effective Anki flashcard creation.

anki_connect_url.title: AnkiConnect URL
anki_connect_url.description: URL of the AnkiConnect server (default: http://localhost:8765)

anki_connect_api_key.title: AnkiConnect API Key
anki_connect_api_key.description: Optional API key if configured in AnkiConnect
